    No oriented cycles after adding arrows at one point #

    Fischbacher, Satz 5.1, first paragraph, in abstract form. Some arrows of a ray category are "new", all starting at one point β; for each new arrow e : β → δ there are old paths u : β ⇝ γ and uₑ : δ ⇝ γ with e uₑ = u ≠ 0. If the old arrows form no oriented cycle and every old path z : δ ⇝ β satisfies z u = uₑ (Lemma 4.2 in the old category), there is no oriented cycle at all (cycleFree_of_step): an oriented cycle gives a closed path e z at β with z old, and then (e z) u = u, contradicting nilpotency.
